name: Otis Wainwright
source_profile:
Halfling · Saddler · Redvale

A gruff, sun-weathered fellow who habitually explains everything through metaphors involving
horses. His principal concern is finishing the day's work before supper.

He maintains an unremarkable but comfortable life with his wife and three children. Though he
occasionally complains about Four-Spur's influence, he is quietly delighted by the number of
new customers its cattle operations bring him.
